name: Ripe mango, fresh whole
storage: Ripen unripe mangoes at room temperature in a paper bag; keep ripe fruit in the fridge and use within about 5 days. Cut flesh can be frozen in boxes for a few months.
looksLike: Oval to kidney-shaped fruit with green, yellow or orange-red skin; ripe flesh is soft, juicy and orange-yellow around a large flat stone.
howToPick: A fruity smell at the stem end, slight give when pressed gently, and a deep colour for the variety. Avoid very soft wet patches, black sunken spots, a sour or fermented smell, and fruit that looks unevenly or too uniformly coloured (a sign of artificial ripening).
shelfLife: Ripe fruit keeps 2 to 3 days at room temperature and about 5 days in the fridge (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Canned mango pulp (about 100 g for 120 g flesh)

usedIn.raw: 120 g peeled flesh per serving (about ½ cup chopped)

mergeNotes: Range 40.0–395.0 was wider than 30% of avg 175.0; narrowed to ±15%.
